fights.notes: Hogan's own account in the New York World, reprinted 1878-11-04. Conflicts with 618, which says Allen beat Hogan at Omaha. Hogan's 38-minute fight with an unnamed opponent (knocked down eleven times) is not clearly Allen, so it is not recorded.
